# coval_test_cases (Data Source)

Lists Coval test cases visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_test_cases" "regression" {
  filter   = "test_set_id=\"abc12345\""
  order_by = "-create_time"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional public API filter expression. Quote string values, such as test_set_id="abc12345".
- `order_by` (String) Optional ordering expression, such as -create_time.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `test_cases` (Attributes List) All matching test-case summaries. Use the singular coval_test_case data source to retrieve dynamic JSON fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--test_cases))

<a id="nestedatt--test_cases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `test_cases`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `expected_behaviors` (List of String)
- `id` (String)
- `input_str` (String)
- `input_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `test_set_id` (String)
- `update_time` (String)
- `user_notes` (String)
